facts.value: To be eligible to take classes at ASU as a nondegree student, you must either be a high school graduate or currently enrolled in high school.
If you are currently enrolled in high school or are under the age of 18, you may be eligible to take classes as a nondegree student.
Before enrolling, ensure you are academically prepared for any college-level course, as these courses and grades will become part of your permanent academic record.
It may be advisable to speak with your high school counselor prior to enrollment.
